libvpx runtime notice

The pinned FFmpeg runtime enables the libvpx VP9 encoder. libvpx is
redistributed under the BSD 3-Clause license (BSD-3-Clause).
The complete license text is available from the SPDX registry:
https://spdx.org/licenses/BSD-3-Clause.html

Upstream source and release information:
https://chromium.googlesource.com/webm/libvpx/

This notice is shipped with every artifact that carries the runtime.
